selectedDefinition: For each unordered pair among the three selected motif vertices, orient the pair by frozen vertex-string order, compute the exact sparse signed difference of width/capacity/depth-histogram token counts, then retain the sorted multiset of all three pair-delta signatures.

findings.statement: The scalar dependency residue factors through the exact pair-delta triangle of the selected motif vertices on all three hard carriers.

Complete selected triple-motif identity is not required by the tested scalar map: exact pairwise structural differences suffice, and on 4x5-k4 reduce structural image rank from 288 to 283 while preserving the full two-bit scalar image.

BASEFREE_TWO_LEG_EXCHANGE is also scalar-exact on all three hard carriers. Under the frozen token-vector semantics it is invariant to common additive translation of all three vertices, so the tested scalar correction can be represented without an absolute base vertex.
Coarse pair-distance norms are insufficient as a common law: EXCHANGE_NORM_TRIANGLE fails on 4x5-k4 and 6x3-k4 even though it passes 6x3-k3.
On 4x5-k4 the exact-delta exchange map has a five-dimensional kernel relative to the selected 288-dimensional triple-motif image, and that kernel is scalar-null.

nonclaims: The lexicographically oriented exact-delta triangle is not claimed to be intrinsically canonical; it is the coarsest passing frozen RS-069 candidate.
Base-free exactness is established for the declared structured token embedding and finite discovery carriers only.
No individual delta key or coefficient is promoted as an invariant scalar syndrome.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
No Q-A/Q-F, universal cubic sufficiency, standard-7x6 qualification, or center-opening proof follows.
next_question: Which parts of the exact pair-delta signatures—changed-coordinate support, sign, parity, or exact magnitude—are load-bearing for the scalar exchange law?
